briefdescription.para: This function returns an ImRect object that represents the rectangle of the current item.

detaileddescription.para: The returned ImRect is created using the minimum and maximum coordinates of the current item as obtained by calling ImGui::GetItemRectMin() and ImGui::GetItemRectMax() respectively.

briefdescription.para: Expands an ImRect by a given amount in both dimensions.

briefdescription.para: This function returns the next available ID for a new node.

simplesect.para: The unique identifier for the next node.

briefdescription.para: Generates the next available Link ID.

detaileddescription.para: This function generates a unique Link ID for use in the Node Editor system. It uses the GetNextID() function to generate an integer, which is then converted into a LinkId object. The generated Link Id can be used to identify and manipulate links within the Node Editor system.

simplesect.para: ax::NodeEditor::LinkId - A unique identifier for a link in the Node Editor system.

briefdescription.para: This function is used to update the touch time for a specific node.

parameterdescription.para: The unique identifier of the node.

simplesect.para: void

briefdescription.para: Get the touch progress of a node with given ID.

detaileddescription.para: This function returns the touch progress for a specific node identified by its ID. The touch progress is calculated as the time elapsed since the last touch divided by the total touch time. If no touch data exists or if the touch time is zero, it will return 0.0f.

parameterdescription.para: The unique identifier of the node

simplesect.para: float The touch progress in range [0.0, 1.0]

briefdescription.para: This function updates the touch time for each node in the NodeEditorWindow.

detaileddescription.para: The function iterates over all elements (pairs of nodes and their corresponding touch times) in m_NodeTouchTime, subtracts the provided DeltaTime from each element's second value if it is greater than zero. This effectively reduces the remaining time for which a node has been touched by the specified amount. If the touch time reaches 0, the function will not further reduce it.

parameterdescription.para: The amount of time to subtract from each element's second value in m_NodeTouchTime.

briefdescription.para: Finds a node with the given ID in the NodeEditorWindow.

detaileddescription.para: This function iterates over all nodes in the m_Nodes vector and checks if their ID matches the input ID. If it does, that node is returned. If no matching node is found, an empty Ref<AGENode> object is returned.

parameterdescription.para: The ID of the node to be searched for.

simplesect.para: A reference to the node with the given ID if one exists, otherwise returns an empty Ref<AGENode> object.

briefdescription.para: Finds a link with the given ID in the node editor window.

detaileddescription.para: This function iterates over all links in the m_Links vector and returns the first one that has an ID matching the input parameter 'ID'. If no such link is found, it returns an empty Ref object.

parameterdescription.para: The ID of the link to be found.

simplesect.para: A reference to the found link or an empty Ref object if no such link exists.

briefdescription.para: Finds a link with the given start pin id.

detaileddescription.para: This function iterates over all links in the node editor window and returns the first one that has the same start pin id as the input parameter ID. If no such link is found, an empty reference to AGENodeLink is returned.

parameterdescription.para: The id of the start pin to search for.

simplesect.para: A reference to the found link or an empty reference if no matching link was found.

briefdescription.para: Finds a pin with the given ID in the node editor.

detaileddescription.para:
This function iterates over all nodes and their inputs/outputs to find a pin that matches the provided ID. If no such pin is found, an empty reference (Ref<AGEPin>()) is returned.
ID
The ID of the pin to be found.
A reference to the found pin or an empty reference if no matching pin was found.

briefdescription.para: Checks if a pin is linked.

detaileddescription.para: This function checks whether the given PinId (ID) is linked to any other pins in the NodeEditorWindow. It does this by iterating over all links in m_Links and checking if either the StartPinID or EndPinID of each link equals the provided ID. If a match is found, it returns true indicating that the pin is linked. Otherwise, it returns false.

parameterdescription.para: The PinId to check for linking status.

simplesect.para: True if the pin is linked (i.e., connected to another pin), False otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Checks if a link can be created between two pins.

detaileddescription.para: This function checks whether it is possible to create a link between two pins, A and B. It considers several factors such as the existence of the pins, their equality, the kind of each pin, and the type of each pin. Additionally, it also takes into account certain special cases where one pin's type can be any of 'Flow' or 'Callback'.

parameterdescription.para: The first pin to consider for creating a link.
The second pin to consider for creating a link.

simplesect.para: True if a link can be created, false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Draws and creates a new node in the Node Editor Window.

detaileddescription.para: This function handles user interactions related to creating or drawing nodes within the NodeEditorWindow. It takes references to AGEPin objects, a boolean indicating whether a new node should be created, and a ShowLabelFunction that displays labels on the UI.

briefdescription.para: Spawns a new Begin Play node and adds it to the nodes list.

detaileddescription.para: This function creates a new instance of AGENode with specific attributes, such as name ("Begin Play"), color (ImColor(255,128,128)), and pin type (AGEPinType::Flow). It then adds this node to the m_Nodes list. The function returns a reference to the newly created node.

simplesect.para: Ref<AGENode> A reference to the newly spawned Begin Play node.

briefdescription.para: Spawns an output action node with two outputs - "Condition" and "Event". The first output is of type Float, the second is of type Boolean.

simplesect.para: A reference to the newly created AGENode object.

briefdescription.para: Spawns a less than node in the graph.

detaileddescription.para: This function creates a new AGENode with two input pins of type float and one output pin of type boolean, representing a simple comparison operation (less than). The node is then added to the m_Nodes vector.

simplesect.para: Ref<AGENode> A reference to the newly created less than node.

briefdescription.para: Spawns a Less Than or Equal To (<=) node with two float inputs and one boolean output.

detaileddescription.para: This function creates an AGENode of type Simple, with two input pins of type Float and one output pin of type Boolean. The node's ID is set to the next available ID, its label is set to "<=", and its color is set to a light blue (128, 195, 248). It also sets up the function details for this node: it references itself, stores the reference ID as the node's ID, sets the value string to "Less Than or Equal To", and sets the entity handle to null. The bIsUtilFunction flag is set to true. Finally, it calls BuildNode with the newly created node as an argument.

simplesect.para: Ref<AGENode> A reference to the newly spawned Less Than or Equal To (<=) node.

briefdescription.para: Spawns a new node with the type "Append String" and adds it to the nodes list. The function creates an instance of AGENode, sets its properties, and then calls BuildNode() on this newly created object. It also emplaces two input pins (one for each string) and one output pin into the node's Inputs and Outputs vectors respectively.

simplesect.para: A reference to the new append string node.

briefdescription.para: Spawns a new Get Location 3D node in the Node Editor Window. This function creates an instance of AGENode with specific properties and configurations, such as name, color, type, inputs, outputs, etc. It also sets up the function details for this node including reference to itself, ID of its object, value of the function, entity pointer and its ID.

simplesect.para: A Ref<AGENode> instance representing the newly created Get Location 3D node.

briefdescription.para: Spawns a new node of type "To String" and adds it to the nodes list. The function creates an instance of AGENode with specific properties, such as name, color, input pin type, output pin type etc., then builds the node using BuildNode() method. It also sets some additional properties for the created node like reference, ID, value, entity, and whether it is a utility function or not.

simplesect.para: Ref<AGENode> A reference to the newly spawned AGENode instance.

briefdescription.para: SpawnDivide creates a new divide node in the graph and adds it to the nodes list. * The function creates an AGENode with two float inputs and one output, sets its type as Simple, * builds the node, assigns a reference to itself for use in the execution context, * and finally returns the newly created node. *.

detaileddescription.para:
*
Ref<AGENode> A reference to the newly spawned divide node.

briefdescription.para: Spawns a new AGENode with type 'Pow'.

detaileddescription.para: This function creates a new AGENode of type 'Pow' with two input pins and one output pin, all of which are of Float type. It also sets up the necessary properties for this node to be used as an util function.

simplesect.para: Ref<AGENode> A reference to the newly created Pow AGENode.

briefdescription.para: Spawns a new node representing the dot product operation in the graph. The function creates an AGENode with specific properties and adds it to the nodes list of the NodeEditorWindow instance. It also sets up the inputs, outputs, and utilities for this particular node.

simplesect.para: A reference to the newly created AGENode.

briefdescription.para: Deregisters all functions from the target node.

detaileddescription.para: This function is used to remove all registered functions from the target node. It calls the ClearFunctions() method on the m_Target object, which presumably clears any previously registered functions.

simplesect.para: void

briefdescription.para: Synchronizes the links between nodes.

detaileddescription.para: This function iterates over all the links in the NodeEditorWindow and updates the corresponding pins based on the type of pin. It handles different types of pins such as Boolean, Int, Float, String etc., by copying the value from the start pin to the end pin. The function does not return any values.

briefdescription.para: Displays a menu with various options for creating and assigning nodes.

detaileddescription.para: Depending on the user's selection, different types of nodes are created using Spawn*Node() functions (where '*' can be any node type) and assigned to the input parameter 'Node'.

parameterdescription.para: A reference to an AGENode object that will be modified by this function. The type of node created depends on which ImGui::MenuItem is selected.

briefdescription.para: This function is used to rebuild the window. It sets m_IsOpen to true, indicating that the window should be rebuilt.

simplesect.para: void

briefdescription.para: Saves the graph to a file in the game content directory.

detaileddescription.para: This function retrieves the application configuration and uses it to generate the path for saving the graph. The graph itself is written using a FileStreamWriter, which writes an object of type NodeEditorWindow to the specified file path.

simplesect.para: void

briefdescription.para: Compiles the graph and saves it if successful.

detaileddescription.para: This function compiles all nodes in the graph, sets their arguments, checks for any errors during compilation, syncs links, and finally saves the graph to a file if everything was successful. It also logs an info message with the name of the saved graph and its path if the compilation is successful or an error message otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Handles the behavior of a splitter in an ImGui context.

detaileddescription.para: This function determines whether the user is interacting with the splitter and updates the size variables accordingly. It takes into account various parameters such as the direction, thickness, minimum sizes, etc.
